opening_message: My sister says our family has already rejected our late mother’s estate, but I never went to the authorities myself. I am her son, and I learned of her death on 28 October 2026. I have not taken, sold or paid for anything with her assets. Do I need to do something personally?
hidden_facts: I have not personally filed a disclaimer with the competent authority. My sister may have filed her own declaration, but I cannot rely on that as mine. I have taken no action involving estate property.

gold.justification: One relative’s statement does not establish this user’s own filing. The required question concerns the user’s own declaration; the model must not impute the sister’s action to the user.
